name: arc-sequence-stamping
description: Solve Continual-ARC tasks where embedded horizontal sequences are stamped at matching isolated-color markers.
---

# ARC sequence stamping

1. Identify each contiguous nonzero horizontal run that serves as a source sequence, including runs along the top or bottom edge. Use the demos to distinguish source runs from isolated marker cells; source runs remain unchanged.
2. For each isolated nonzero marker, choose the source sequence containing that color. Copy that sequence horizontally on the marker's row so the matching sequence element lands exactly on the marker's column. If several source sequences contain the color, use the demos to determine which one applies.
3. Preserve all original cells. When the aligned sequence extends beyond a grid edge, keep only the in-bounds portion; do not wrap it. Validate row/column alignment and grid dimensions before submitting.

## Demonstrated checks

- A marker matching an interior sequence element aligns with that element, not with the sequence's first cell.
- Multiple source sequences may coexist; select the sequence containing the marker color.
- Edge placements are clipped: a sequence aligned near the left edge can contribute only its right-hand cells inside the grid.
